schema: INFORMATION_AUDIT_HANDOFF.md, Instructions for the Forms lane

provenance.status: HS001's development cohort (post hoc for any identity analysis once HS001's results are read)
provenance.inclusion: every block of the stage, all four founders (formation failures included, flagged), both recipient lineages, every arm and checkpoint; no exclusion
provenance.missing: none: every exported array is written for every block; the per-generation maintenance states are not exported (they never cross a boundary)

boundaries.incoming: packets_initial_*: the record bytes at acquisition (E001's generic capture, E006's codec at the budget)
boundaries.maintenance: each generation reads the incoming record into a fresh body (300 steps, read_off off), erases, and writes a new record (1,000 steps); only record bytes cross (E014); not exported per generation
boundaries.outgoing: packets_checkpoint: the record after n rewrites
boundaries.recipient: recipient_*: a fresh body that read the outgoing (or protected) record on the shared terminal stream; it never feeds back into the lineage
boundaries.outside: the prototypes, the labels and the founder order stay outside every native reader and writer; public coordinates, the dynamics and the codecs are shared apparatus outside the byte budget (E014)

evaluator/prototypes.meaning: the candidate dictionary: each founder's mean field over the last 100 of its 1,000 formation steps (E001); an evaluator resource, never a reader or writer input

evaluator/prototype_halves.meaning: the same over each half of those 100 steps (E001's stability check)

f<F>/packets_initial_lineage.meaning: the lineage arms' incoming records at acquisition (E006's initial packets; arms rewrite, foreign, erased, background)

f<F>/packets_initial_protected.meaning: the protected records' exact bytes (copy, copy_foreign, copy_erased, copy_background), constant at every boundary

f<F>/packets_checkpoint.meaning: each lineage's outgoing record after n rewrites (the bytes a fresh checkpoint reader receives)

f<F>/recipient_checkpoint.axes: (checkpoint 16, founder 4, recipient 2, arm 4, component 3, row 16, col 16)
f<F>/recipient_checkpoint.meaning: the fresh checkpoint reader's state after its 300 reading steps (terminal stream; components v, ema, ref); v is what E014's observer scores

f<F>/recipient_protected.meaning: the same reader on the protected records (constant across horizons)

labels/lineage_source_founder.meaning: the founder whose acquired record the lineage started from: own f, foreign (f + 1) mod 4, -1 for erased and background

labels/protected_source_founder.meaning: the same for the protected records

labels/formation_qualified.meaning: E014's formation qualification per founder (all founders kept)

ids/background_id.meaning: the shared formation background's ID (E001 draws it per block: the block number)

ids/founder.meaning: founder indices within the block (positions only: no meaning across blocks)

ids/recipient.meaning: the two recipient lineages per founder

target.definition: which of the block's four founders' acquired records a lineage or protected read started from (k = 4, uniform prior 1/4 within the block); erased and background lineages have none (-1)
target.candidate_dictionary: evaluator/prototypes (the same set for own, foreign and protected records)
target.nuisance: the block's shared background (ids/background_id); the budget; the horizon
target.coordinate_tolerance: none: the native reader, the writer and E014's observer act cell by cell at the shared coordinates of the 16 x 16 torus; no translation, rotation, reflection or sign tolerance; a decoder that allows any must declare it as a different task
target.distinct_tasks: four-founder matching is the declared task; family, phase and fine-detail recovery are not interchangeable with it and are not declared here

decoder: none fitted in HS001; identity decoding is a separate post hoc audit, frozen and reviewed on its own
outcomes_kept_separate: E014's qualified (Q), sign-only (S) and amplitude (|v| > 0.2) outcomes are in the shards, not in the export
e014_cohort: no identity export: its raw lineage fields are on the producing host only (/home/robert/Random-Replications/WhereDoFormsComeFrom/experiments/E014_long_renewal/runs/confirmation_v2/; hashes in E014's runs/confirmation_v2/COMPLETE.json, sha256 80f52dfbeb0f851d...)
